constraint: Consumer layer cannot read activation before producer layer commits it to feature SRAM or DRAM spill path.
note: Current runtime uses feature residency plan and slot tagging.

constraint: Current FPS/KNN query xyz block must be loaded into query SRAM before repeated reads by dist2engine; once loaded it can be reused across key-tile scans.
note: Runtime export support added; full event generation pending.

constraint: Each key xyz tile must be refilled from DRAM into key SRAM before the corresponding dist2engine scan can start.
note: Covers src-read plus tgt-write semantics for each key tile.

constraint: Same feature SRAM slot is exclusive; without pipeline a single slot is reused serially.
Adjacent layers may overlap only when using different slots under double buffering.
note: Current runtime has slot tags; fine-grain overlap still conservative.

constraint: ACC keeps the same feature-SRAM-first policy as baseline, but removes repeated weight refill because weights stay resident in RRAM-CIM.
note: Feature movement, not weight staging, is the dominant cross-layer memory path.

constraint: For the first 10% FPS points, ACC still follows full-sort FPS: each 128-distance block updates the min-distance table and updates the running max candidate before the predictor is ready.
note: No coarse/fine speculative thresholding is used during the warmup prefix.

constraint: After at least two exact FPS radii points exist, downsampling/resampler work may overlap the main full-sort FPS loop while the warmup prefix continues growing.
note: The same temp_max_distance_sram is time-multiplexed for max candidates and speculative radii staging.

constraint: Coarse/fine FPS can start only after the first 10% exact FPS points are complete, the predictor emits the 64-point radii curve, and upsampling reconstructs the full radii schedule.
note: Until then, FPS remains in full-sort mode.

constraint: Once the whole predicted radii curve is ready, ACC switches FPS from full-sort to coarse/fine filtering using the predicted threshold schedule.
note: KNN is unaffected and stays in dynamic-threshold mode throughout.

constraint: ACC KNN keeps dynamic-threshold filtering for all blocks; candidate writes to topk SRAM and threshold-refinement rereads continue until fine-filter bandwidth is satisfied.
note: Independent from the FPS speculative-radii path.

constraint: AffineNorm/SPool/KAT/ReLU/Add/LayerNorm may start on a chunk only after the corresponding feature chunk is visible in feature SRAM.
note: Matches chunked feature pipeline semantics; runtime still coarse for most nonlinear ops.

constraint: Nonlinear workspace SRAM is shared across AffineNorm/SPool/KAT/Pool-like operators and is exclusive within each active operator window.
note: Future runtime path should map individual ops to this shared workspace resource.

constraint: AffineNorm/LayerNorm/KAT parameter or LUT SRAM must be resident before the corresponding nonlinear engine evaluates the chunk.
note: Small-parameter SRAM is expected to stay resident across many chunks/operators.

constraint: ADD waits for both main tensor and residual tensor to be available; residual may come from feature SRAM or DRAM refill in conservative mode.
note: Residual path can be forced to DRAM in the current conservative baseline assumption.

constraint: Operator-local systolic feature SRAM is serialized on the shared local buffer resource.
With double buffering, key xyz tile refill for tile k+1 may overlap distance compute consuming tile k from the companion slot.
note: Ping-pong key SRAM is the intended baseline/base_v2 distance frontend model.

constraint: Distance SRAM write and sorter read must serialize when they target the same shared dist SRAM resource/bank.
note: Current runtime models shared resource IDs; bank-level refinement can be added later.

constraint: FPS min-distance table update and sorter read are mutually exclusive on the same logical table region.
